scarce_history_response_replacement.inference_unit: Average three seeds within each held context first; 43 biological-context pairs, never129 independent seed replicates. agent_initial_same_cards.scope: ContextBuilder/EvidenceLedger evidence context responsibility only. Raw public assertions are the endpoint; no biological ground truth, target engagement, RNA outcome, functional utility, unseen-edge generalization, or module promotion.

agent_hard_repeated.unit_boundary: Presentation repeats test order robustness on the same twelve exposed cases, not independent biology or a fresh holdout dataset.
agent_hard_repeated.diagnosis: Both LLM arms always inspected exact_identity then mechanism. Main failures were null for a required boolean, some unsupported family scope, and mechanism-only routing that omitted the requested assay source. Missing identity is not supported as a diagnosis. The prototype hard final prompt types were less explicit than the easy contract; do not generalize this to the entire production agent.
agent_hard_repeated.scope: Budgeted cached-source tool selection on already exposed fixed12cases; 3presentation orders, not independent biology or fresh generalization.

post_hoc_offline_admission.scope: Strict admission retains or abstains; it does not repair retrieval or reasoning. Separate receipt rendering deterministically reconstructs only already purchased source assertions, not null coercion or rescued LLM advantage. Omitted/unpurchased source records cannot be recovered. Explicit source flag false means no qualifying inspected annotation, never negative biology.
post_hoc_offline_admission.interpretation: Admission retains or abstains without null coercion; separately rendered source receipts reconstruct only purchased assertions and miss unpurchased assay evidence. This deterministic substitution does not rescue LLM/MAP efficacy.

claim_limits: Signed39geneRNA utility is an RNA endpoint, not viability, ATP, synergy, protein activity, engagement or mechanism proof.
STATE pretraining unchanged; scarce downstream labels only. Reference contexts overlap pretraining, five targets exposed, graph pretraining exposure unknown.
Nominal paired context intervals and repeated development experiments are not independent biological confirmation or calibrated-risk certification.
Known-graph retrieval uses a target-enriched1241protein gallery and may reproduce pretrained facts; no genome-wide/new-edge validity.
B/confidence9 and direct_interaction/family source assertions do not prove physical binding or gene-selective cellular effect in the requested case.
Source-typed knowledge is feasible; tested accuracy/RNA decisions do not justify a production module replacement.
Native MAP RNA remains blocked by checkpoint-matched old forward semantics, ordered2000HVG output axis and target scale. More weights alone do not supply these contracts.
